status: Clarifications required before freeze; implementation not reviewed

findings.issue: Zero-HP actor admission is not globally defined
findings.example: Generic admission forbids dead actors, but travel/explore/wait/pickup/loot/buy and transfer do not expressly require standing. An implementer can permit an unconscious actor to travel or loot while following the written per-action rules.
findings.requested_rule: Every actor command except rest requires hp>0; rest alone permits hp=0. Combat additionally requires actor_id to equal the current order[turn].

findings.issue: Elapsed time, supply damage, hazard/reward and capacity ordering is unspecified
findings.example: A1HP actor without rations/water explores a ration reward. Reward-before-time can avoid starvation; time-before-reward can kill. The contract only states that admitted travel finishes at its destination on death, leaving admitted exploration outcome uncertain. Different order also changes deterministic draws.
findings.requested_rule: Specify one exact operation order, debit/preflight rules, and whether admitted hazard/search/reward finishes after actor becomes unconscious or dead. Do not let reward availability retroactively satisfy a preflight supply requirement unless intentionally specified.

findings.issue: Actor view promises no exact API/field whitelist
findings.example: Permitted encounter facts is undefined, while raw event/receipt effects can include other participants supply damage/resources.
findings.requested_rule: Define the closed viewer projection before exposing it, or explicitly defer the view API and keep raw snapshots/events/receipts host-only.

findings.issue: Duplicate request-ID rejection is assigned to storage without a whole-history replay rule
findings.example: Pure event creation can construct consecutive otherwise-valid signed events reusing request_id with different command/current cursor; state has no dedup map. Whole-history replay needs its own seen-ID index to reject histories storage would refuse.
findings.requested_rule: Require replayMortal and persisted-history validation to reject duplicate request_id; describe verifyMortalEvent as structural/transition verification that needs an external index for history-wide uniqueness.

pending_changes_excluded: round_participants and exactly-once six-second charging including same-round escape
